title: GTA6 Original Score Now Available for Preorder Featuring Justice
description: GTA6 Hub reports on the latest IGN Games news: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score is now available to preorder on CD and vinyl, featuring a three-hour compilation of new music from Justice.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Original Score Preorders Officially Open

As anticipation builds for the next chapter in Rockstar Games' iconic open-world franchise, the first major glimpse into the audio landscape of the game has arrived. According to a recent report by IGN Games, *Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score* is now officially available for fans to preorder, giving enthusiasts a concrete piece of the game's ecosystem to secure ahead of launch.

## A Massive Three-Hour Audio Experience by Justice

According to the details released alongside the preorder announcement, this upcoming release is far from a standard compilation. The original score spans an impressive three hours in total duration, featuring an entirely new collection of music crafted by the acclaimed electronic music duo, Justice. Known for their distinct electronic soundscapes, Justice's involvement points toward a deeply immersive and stylish auditory experience that fits right into the vibrant world of GTA6.

## CD and Vinyl Options for Collectors

For physical media collectors and audiophiles, Rockstar and the associated labels are offering multiple ways to own the music. The *GTA6 Original Score* is available to preorder in both CD and vinyl formats. This dual-format physical release caters directly to modern collectors who appreciate the tactile nature of vinyl records as well as traditional CD enthusiasts. Given the legendary status of previous soundtracks in the franchise, these physical editions are expected to be highly sought-after collector's items.

## The Cultural Legacy of GTA Soundtracks

Music has always been a vital cornerstone of the Grand Theft Auto experience, defining the era, the attitude, and the atmosphere of every fictional city R星 has created. By highlighting a massive three-hour original score early in the rollout, it underscores the developer's continued dedication to high-production-value audio design. While we await further updates on the game itself, this soundtrack announcement provides a strong taste of the artistic direction powering GTA6.

## Editor's Take

Music is the beating heart of any Grand Theft Auto title, and a three-hour original score by Justice is a massive statement of intent. Offering both CD and vinyl versions shows a deep understanding of collector culture. It's an exciting early drop that proves the audio side of GTA6 will match the monumental scale of the game world.
